title: Wall Street Meowgnate
subtitle: Three choices, only one makes money
description: A suited cat walks into the New York Feline Exchange. Seven trading moments, eighteen choices, and every company is a cat-world business built from fish, cans, snacks, scratchboards, boxes, catnip, or cat grass.

catalog.eyebrow: A sixth glimmer has woken up
catalog.headline: The cat's face is the market.
catalog.description: Three choices, only one makes money. Pick right for coin eyes, pick wrong for dead-fish eyes.
catalog.cardDescription: A suited cat enters the New York Feline Exchange. Every company only sells cat-world goods: fresh fish, cans, snacks, scratchboards, boxes, catnip, and cat grass. Every question has one profitable answer, and your cat's face tells the story.
catalog.actionSummary: Pick stocks · Faces · Rich or broke

scenes.title: The opening bell
scenes.description: 9:00 AM at the New York Feline Exchange. An orange tabby cat in a suit walks in with a briefcase, a trading screen full of red and green arrows, and five thousand cat coins.

start.text: The cat opens its terminal, ears standing like antennas. The screen flashes: today's cat coins will not sit idle.

scenes.title: Fresh fish revolution
scenes.description: A flash alert: "Big Tuna Fishing Fleet returned with full holds this morning." Every cat on the floor just perked up.

mosla.text: The morning catch is confirmed. Big Tuna Fishing Fleet hits the ceiling limit. Your cat's eyes have turned into two glowing gold coins, and drool is pooling on the keyboard.

can.text: FishCan Group stayed flat. Your cat yawns for a full three seconds and squeezes out one bored tear.

reit.text: Scratch Castle Boardworks lost orders to cheaper sisal rolls. Your cat's pupils dilate, its face crumples into a wet ball of yarn, and the screen shows one thick red candle.

scenes.title: Catnip panic
scenes.description: Flash alerts are raining: "Catnip Fields reports a rainy-season shortage, and the entire catnip sector is deep red." The cat next to you quietly shrinks its screen.

actions.name: Run into Dried Fish Snack Co. for safety
actions.hint: In a panic, cats stock up on food

actions.name: Buy the dip on Catnip Fields
actions.hint: It's fallen so far, it must bounce

can2.text: The scarcer catnip becomes, the more cats hoard food. Dried Fish Snack Co. goes up while catnip burns. Your cat narrows its eyes and the corners of its mouth curl up — this is a cat's victory smile.

catnip2.text: Catnip Fields keeps falling, straight through the floor. Your cat's gaze starts to wander, pupils reflecting a green waterfall, mouth slightly open and forgotten.

laser.text: Feather Wand Workshop fell too. Your cat tilts its head sideways, as if considering whether to scratch that red line off the screen with its paw.

scenes.title: The mystery whale
scenes.description: You spot a cat in sunglasses making a call in the corner. After it hangs up, huge buy orders for Tuna Tide Cannery start flooding the tape.

actions.name: Follow the whale into Tuna Tide Cannery

can3.text: The sunglasses cat turns out to be the Big Tuna Cat Tycoon. Tuna Tide Cannery gets taken over and the stock jumps. Your cat lies flat on the desk, both paws clutching the terminal, eyes turned into two enlarged gold coin symbols.

calico.text: Calico FishSnack Group issues a profit warning. Your cat's ears instantly flatten into two airplane wings and its whole face stretches into a bitter melon shape.

sun.text: Cardboard Castle Workshop loses heat to a new line of extra-thick boxes. Your cat sneezes and sniffles.

scenes.title: Ration rumors
scenes.description: The keeper of the Nine Lives Cat Pantry clears its throat: "We cannot rule out that at some future point... possibly... consider... tightening dried fish redemption." Before the sentence ends, the whole board is already red.

actions.name: Sell everything, buy a cat-food reserve can
Double down on Claws & Carpets Scratchboards
actions.hint: A dip is a buying opportunity

reserve.text: The cat-food reserve can holds its value. It's not much, but on a day when everything is red, your cat smiles the smile of a cat that has seen through worldly illusions.

reit4.text: Scratchboard stocks hit the floor limit. Your cat's body slowly slides off the chair until only two paws hang from the edge of the desk, eyes showing nothing but white.

box.text: Silvervine Vineyard's leaves get soaked by rain. Your cat curls up on its chair like a flattened cardboard box.

scenes.title: The sunglasses cat's note
scenes.description: The sunglasses cat walks past your desk and slips a note under your keyboard. The note shows a drawing of a cardboard box and an upward arrow. It doesn't look back.

actions.name: Trust the cat, all-in Cardboard Kingdom Workshop
Don't trust it, buy PurrStick Snack Workshop
actions.hint: Snack sticks never go out of style

box5.text: The Big Tuna Cat Tycoon announces a premium acquisition of Cardboard Kingdom Workshop. The stock explodes upward. Your cat tapes the note to its screen and its eyes narrow into two victorious arcs.

fin.text: PurrStick Snack Workshop stays perfectly flat. Your cat stares at the note with the box and the arrow, and its entire face sags two centimeters from the corners of its mouth downward.

police.text: The police cat arrives, and the sunglasses cat disappears into the crowd. You didn't make or lose money, but you earn the title of "Justice Cat." Your cat puts on a tiny police hat.

scenes.title: Five minutes to close
scenes.description: Only five minutes left on the clock. You still have some cat coins, and one thing you can do: go all-in on one stock, or convert everything to cash.

actions.name: All-in Cat Grass Farm
actions.hint: It has to bounce this time

mosla6.text: Moonlight Mice Ranch announces a bumper midnight harvest. It hits the ceiling in the final minute. Your cat literally flies off its chair, eyes spinning into two vortexes of cash.

catgrass6.text: Cat Grass Farm announces a crop failure in the last minute. Your cat's face turns from pink to grey, from grey to transparent, and finally into a stationary cat-shaped outline.

cash.text: You convert everything to cash. Your cat hugs its wallet, curls into a ball, and shows two alert eyes. Not rich, but at least it's not eating cat treats for dinner tonight.

endings.title: Filthy Rich · Coin Eyes Fully Open
endings.description: Every stock you picked went up. Cats on the floor started calling you "The Orange Coin Prophet." When you walk out, a crowd of cats follows you shouting "Big bro, take me with you!" Your face has become two giant spinning gold coins.

endings.title: Steady Cat · Alive Is Enough
endings.description: You didn't get rich, and you didn't go broke. You sit on the bench outside the exchange, take a can of cat food from your briefcase, and quietly eat it. Today's market is over.

endings.title: Bankrupt · Cat-Shaped Outline
endings.description: You got escorted out. The security cat says: "Don't come back tomorrow." You sit on the steps for a long time, watching cats go in and out. Then you stand up, dust off your suit, and walk toward the cat treat factory. Tomorrow you still have to work.
